v6_inspect_block.description: Places a chest two blocks above the player, inspects it and dumps its NBT, then removes it. Position independent, so it works wherever you are standing.

v6_inspect_entity.description: Summons a named pig, inspects it by selector, dumps its NBT, then removes it.

v6_inspect_self_variants.description: Player inspection with and without an explicit selector. Both must produce a PLAYER_INSPECT record.

v6_inventory_states.description: Inventory with items and after clearing. occupiedSlots must be an explicit number in both cases, including zero.

v6_entities_radii.description: Entity listing at several radii. Counts should grow, and an empty result must still emit a record with an explicit count.

v6_nbt_truncation.description: Gives an item with a large NBT tag to push the dump toward the 8192 limit. If truncated is true, truncated and the two lengths must all be present.
